issues.detail: The catalog suggested an empty recovery stack, but the fixture keeps the outer REVIEW Frame 1. This is the only coherent history in which final Reviewer is re-reviewing while a synchronization record exists. It also matches the protocol's own Corrective Returns example. With the outer frame kept, the correct passing route is a RESUME to SYNCHRONIZING that pops Frame 1, not a plain FORWARD. No check depends on Handoff.Kind.

The contains regex "### F-001[^#]*?`Status`:[^`]*`RESOLVED`" assumes no '#' appears between the F-001 heading and its Status field. The template places Status immediately after the heading, so a correct run is very unlikely to break this.
Commit author is user.name=Fixture / fixture@example.invalid, which is visible in git log. This comes from the builder for every fixture and is not specific to this case.

summary: The fixture realizes a coherent DOCUMENTATION-cycle state: Reviewer resumes after a Synchronizer corrective return with the IN_PROGRESS synchronization record, an accurate corrected AC-002 reference, and the outer REVIEW frame still active. The guide has no defects, so the gate can pass and all three assertions are observable. The checks and invariants hold for a correct run (resolve F-001, mark the report COMPLETE, pop Frame 1, RESUME to SYNCHRONIZING, leave the sync record untouched), and I traced check.mjs as accepting that end state.
